Independence Hall (Extremis Malis)

The Philadelphia historical-site setting used by Extremis Malis as a Founders weapons cache and the key evidence location in Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward's investigation.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Evidence cache

In the graphic novel's fictional setting, Independence Hall functions as both a weapons cache and an intelligence lead. It is included for its source-specific lore role, not as a depiction of the real site's current condition or operations. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Extremis Malis depicts Independence Hall as a Founders cache where Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward find equipment linking the group to Mantis's operation. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The Division team recovers satellite-communications evidence at the location, shifting the investigation from the Founders toward the wider East Coast network. [1]
